main_text.l: rino in Latinum malè conversa postea
vir in Ju-dæorum Libris diu multumque
Morini exercitationes vocat Librum cruda & indigesta materiæ
mole infertum & confertum, ubi testimonia autorum Ju-
Buxtorfius, quàm multis in locis lapsus
interpretatus est. In hoc tamen & ipse er-
ravit Buxtorfius, dum totus à Rabbino-
primas gentis Hebræ[?] literas, in quibus
esse Hebræas, non verò Samaritanas seu
poris in plerisque Europæ partibus ita ce-
{t} In dissert. Philol. Theol. edit. Basil. in 4. Anno 1645.

page.notes: The text is set in one column with an indented first line on paragraph starts. The first line's opening words are cut off at the top edge of the page, and the first paragraph continues from the previous page. Some letter forms ("Hebræ[?]", the ligatures and the "Mo-rino" join) are not certain; the spacing in the first line blurs the word boundaries between "testimonia" and "Morino". The ligature "æ" in "Hebræ" is uncertain. The running head is set with wide letter spacing as "V I T A" and is given as VITA. Show-through and the blurred right edge are not transcribed.
